releases.title: Brotli security update
changes: Address the Brotli vulnerability CVE-2026-111497 with Node.js 24.22.1 in Docker and a minimum patched runtime for native startup.
Native users: update to Node.js 24.22.1 or newer in the 24.x line and restart CopeNOW. Docker users: rebuild with --pull and recreate the container.

releases.title: Docker setup and preview deployments
changes: Run CopeNOW with Docker Compose, with personal settings and history preserved between updates.
Inspect component versions and commits in preview deployments, including deployed packages missing from the package catalog.

releases.title: Initial release
changes: Monitor application health, builds and deployment changes across environments in one workspace.
